description: This Java source file defines a class 'CommonServices' providing various utility and service methods for the Apache OFBiz framework, including testing, debugging, entity creation, and metrics management.

classes.name: CommonServices
classes.description: A utility class providing various static methods for common service operations within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: testService
methods.description: A simple test service that logs input context and returns a success response.

methods.name: testSOAPService
methods.description: Creates and returns a list of test 'TestingNode' entities.

methods.name: blockingTestService
methods.description: Simulates a blocking service by sleeping for a specified duration before calling testService.

methods.name: testRollbackListener
methods.description: Registers a rollback service and returns an error message.

methods.name: testCommitListener
methods.description: Registers a commit service and returns success.

methods.name: createNote
methods.description: Creates a new note record with provided details.

methods.name: adjustDebugLevels
methods.description: Sets debugging levels based on input parameters.

methods.name: forceGc
methods.description: Invokes garbage collection.

methods.name: echoService
methods.description: Returns the input context as response.

methods.name: returnErrorService
methods.description: Returns an error message for testing error handling.

methods.name: conditionTrueService
methods.description: Returns success with conditionReply=true.

methods.name: conditionFalseService
methods.description: Returns success with conditionReply=false.

methods.name: entityFailTest
methods.description: Attempts to create an entity with invalid data to cause a referential integrity error.

methods.name: entitySortTest
methods.description: Logs a sorted list of model entity names.

methods.name: makeALotOfVisits
methods.description: Creates multiple 'Visit' entities for testing.

methods.name: displayXaDebugInfo
methods.description: Displays transaction resource debug info if enabled.

methods.name: byteBufferTest
methods.description: Writes ByteBuffer contents to files.

methods.name: uploadTest
methods.description: Handles file upload, creating data resource and content entries.

methods.name: mcaTest
methods.description: Logs details of a MimeMessage.

methods.name: streamTest
methods.description: Reads from input stream and writes to output stream.

methods.name: ping
methods.description: Checks database sequence count and returns a message.

methods.name: getAllMetrics
methods.description: Retrieves and returns all metrics.

methods.name: resetMetric
methods.description: Resets a specified metric by name.
